title: First App release to Apple thanks to Ai - Introducing Nightporch!
author: Shortykane
selftext:
After years of messing with Ai I am finally releasing my first app to the apple store publicly! Though it isn't my most recent update, it's pretty fun! 

I present you... Nightporch! 

Nightporch is if you took a horde zombie game and made it into a town simulator.   
You can play with friends or by yourself, but I definitely recommend it with friends!

[‎Nightporch App - App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nightporch/id6812076093)

More information at my site (also created by Ai) [Nightporch — Spicy Human](https://spicyhuman.com/games/hearth-and-horde/)

If you want something a little Chaotic and quicker pace, I recommend Classic   
If you want a more slow build your space version over time I'd say go for Homestead

I have so many updates planned and ready to go! 

Please be SUPER brutal. I want to make this the best it can be.
